voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In nineteen twelve, a rare book dealer named Wilfrid Voynich bought a manuscript that no one could read.
About two hundred and forty pages, handwritten, in a script no one has ever identified.
Page after page of plants. Almost none can be clearly identified.
In two thousand nine, carbon dating placed its parchment in the early fourteen hundreds.
Codebreakers, linguists, and computers have all tried. It has never been convincingly deciphered.
